name: Coral
summary: Flat vector coral clump in branch, brain or sea-fan form with a gentle sway; use as reef scenery.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; about 360 px tall at s = 1

params.name: variant
params.note: branch = branching tubes; brain = domed brain coral; fan = sea fan on a stem

params.name: pose
params.note: idle = gentle sway from p.f; sway = larger sway

params.name: color
params.note: coral colour (hex); shading is derived from it

author: krakujs
